oracle_usage: Diagnostic comparison only; never an estimator or AIPW input.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across eight paired cells; Clopper-Pearson for warning rates and Student-t intervals for paired crossfit-minus-in-sample false-warning differences.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic diagnostic audit only. Cross-fitted propensity diagnostics and oracle diagnostics do not establish real-world identification.
prohibited_changes: Do not pass oracle propensity into the propensity fit or AIPW estimator.
Do not interpret the report as a cross-fitted AIPW treatment-effect estimate.
Do not treat oracle propensity as observable in real observational data.
